verdict.rationale: Dev-handoff inspection is a fair question for a design tool like Canva, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a developer inspect mode, layer measurements, style extraction, or CSS/iOS/Android code snippets, nor any viewer-seat access for this purpose. Design export formats and REST/MCP APIs are related features or developer building blocks, not the inspect capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat
